topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Hallmarks Framework
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic establishes the lecture structure, learning outcomes, and the historical hallmarks of cancer framework.

topics.label: Autonomous Growth Signaling and Evasion of Growth Suppression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in receptor tyrosine kinases, Wnt/APC, and downstream cascades drive continuous cell proliferation and bypass growth inhibition.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Cancers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how mutations disrupt normal cell maturation and lock cells in proliferative progenitor states in blood cancers and intestinal epithelium.

topics.label: Resistance to Programmed Cell Death
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the molecular mechanisms by which tumor cells evade apoptosis through p53 inactivation and the dysregulation of Bax and BCL2.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how telomere dynamics, telomerase reactivation, and p53-mediated stress pathways govern cellular senescence and immortalization.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Epigenetic Rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the metabolic adaptations of cancer cells, including aerobic glycolysis and Krebs cycle mutations that generate oncometabolites to alter the epigenome.

topics.label: Induction of Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes how tumors trigger new blood vessel formation to overcome diffusion limits for oxygen and nutrients.

topics.label: Invasion and the Metastatic Cascade
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the biological steps, clinical tracking, microenvironmental interactions, and genomic characteristics of cancer metastasis.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a summary of how hallmarks integrate, highlights recent literature, and transitions to practical sessions.
